examName: Statistical Research Officer, Group B in Directorate of Economics and Statistics, GSS, Gr-B
examNameMr: सहाय्यक सांख्यिकी अधिकारी, सामान्य राज्य सेवा, अर्थ व सांख्यिकी संचालनालय, गट-ब

papers.paperTitle: General Studies, Aptitude Test and Statistics
papers.paperTitleMr: सामान्य ज्ञान, बुद्धिमापन चाचणी आणि सांख्यिकी

topics: History of India with special reference to Maharashtra
Geography of India with special reference to Maharashtra
Indian Polity and Governance, State Administration and Local Government (Rural and Urban) - Structure, powers and functions
Indian Economy
General Science
Current Affairs of National and International importance
Logical reasoning
Mental ability and analytical aptitude
Data Collection: Type of data, Quantitative and Qualitative data, Data for univariate and multivariate cases, Sources of data collection - Primary and Secondary Sources

Presentation of Data: Preparation of frequency tables - Univariate, Bivariate and Multivariate; Diagrammatic and Graphical presentation of data and its interpretation (Histogram, Ogives, Frequency Curve)
Elementary Statistical Methods: Measures of Central tendency, Measures of Dispersion, Concepts of skewness and Kurtosis, Correlation and Regression

Probability: Concept of probability, Elementary laws of probability, Conditional probability, Bayes Theorem, Theory of Expectations, Theoretical Probability Distributions - Binomial, Poisson and Normal
Theory of Statistical Inference: Theory of Estimation, Hypothesis Testing - Small and Large sample tests
Interpretation of Linear Models: Models with one and more explanatory variables, Significance of regression coefficients, Goodness of fit
Sampling Methods: Simple Random Sampling, Stratified Random Sampling, Systematic Sampling, Cluster Sampling, Multistage Sampling, Use of auxiliary information
Index Numbers and Time Series: Index Numbers - Types and methods of construction; Time Series Analysis - Components and fitting of trend

Statistical Organizations in India: Central Statistical Organization, National Sample Survey Organization, State Directorate of Economics and Statistics, RBI, Registrar General of India, Types of data collected
Vital Statistics in India: Different Birth Rates and death rates, Gross and Net reproduction rates, Infant Mortality rate, Life tables
National Income Estimation: Methods of National Income estimation concepts (GDP, NDP, GNP, NNP)
Latest and recent developments in the above topics

importantNotes: Final merit list will be based on the combined marks obtained in the objective examination and interview.
